godmother of CMY

She married (19 Aug 1814) the Rev. Leveson Vernon Harcourt.  Her will was proved (c. £45,000) by her adopted daughter the Hon. Caroline Mary Frances Jervis, of West Hay, Somerset and the Hon. William Monk Jervis. [PB; wills index]
